_about: Held-out policy questions, written from a read of data/kb/*.md BEFORE any retrieval variant was run on them, then frozen (the file's sha256 is recorded in every results file). Settings are chosen on dev_queries.json; this set is only used to confirm them. acceptable_headings is any-of: a result counts when its heading path contains one of the strings, and every chunk listed actually contains the information that answers the question. Written by the same engineer who built the retriever, so it is a check against over-fitting to the dev set, not an independent audit.
